channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad nacionalizam debate com Lava Jato e 'caos na saúde'
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) nationalized the São Paulo gubernatorial debate by referencing the Lava Jato operation and criticizing previous health policies, highlighting disagreements on corruption and public policies. The exchange underscored the polarized tone between the candidates.

item.title: Arrecadação com 'imposto do pecado' vai cair sem bets, e governo terá de compensar com demais setores
item.description: Lula's ban on online betting will reduce tax revenue from the selective tax, requiring fiscal compensation from other sectors, complicating the 2027 tax reform implementation.

item.title: Renan Santos critica uso de Nossa Senhora Aparecida em discursos políticos
item.description: Renan Santos criticized the use of religion in political speeches, particularly the dispute involving Our Lady of Aparecida between the candidates of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. He stated he would never use his faith for electoral purposes and considered the religious instrumentalization 'horrible' and 'humiliating'. He also attacked Supreme Court justices, calling them political agents.

item.title: Flávio e Tarcísio escolhem interior de SP para último ato de campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas chose the interior of São Paulo for their final campaign event, with rallies in Santa Bárbara d'Oeste and Americana on Saturday (3). The decision avoids the capital due to logistical constraints and targets regional voters. São Paulo was a strategic focus in the final stretch.

item.title: Tarcísio chama Haddad de Pinóquio em debate ao falar sobre mães atípicas
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas called Fernando Haddad a Pinocchio during a TV Globo debate when discussing policies for atypical mothers. Haddad criticized the governor for allegedly supporting ex-councilman Milton Leite before his arrest. The debate was marked by heated exchanges over public policies and corruption suspicions.

item.title: Amigo de Flávio e R$ 5 bi em bet: focinho, pata e pelo de gato. Será gato?
item.description: Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro and already under investigation for suspected fraud in the INSS, is believed to have wagered R$ 10 billion in online betting in 2023, with at least R$ 5 billion in net transactions. The suspicion of money laundering is under review by the Federal Police, though the source of the funds remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Na Bahia, Lula diz a aliados estar preocupado com crise no STF
item.description: During a rally in Salvador, President Lula expressed concern over the crisis at the Supreme Federal Court and its politicization, without naming any specific ministers. He rejected the possibility of a joint vote for ACM Neto and emphasized concerns about judicial reform. The STF crisis has worsened following messages involving banker Daniel Vorcaro and controversial judicial decisions.

item.title: Nikolas a Lula e Janja: “Canalha é quem foi preso por corrupção”
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) responded to criticisms from President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and First Lady Janja Lula, calling them 'scoundrels' and countering the president's statements about medical exams. The exchange of insults occurred after Lula labeled Nikolas a 'scoundrel' and Janja called him a 'bad kid' during campaign rallies.

item.title: Zema condiciona desistência a movimento em bloco e diz que anuncia apoio no 2º turno no domingo
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) says he will not withdraw before the first round but will announce support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round. He rejects pre-election alliance pressures, stressing unity against the PT only after the first round. Zema also celebrates the TSE decision to include him in presidential debates.

item.title: Eleição sem debate
item.description: Lula is likely to skip the TV Globo debate, leaving the first round without a direct confrontation between candidates. The lack of a third front reinforces polarization between pro and anti-PT candidates.

item.title: Assista ao vídeo de Lula sobre câncer de próstata e mulher “tomar toque”
item.description: Lula stated at a rally in Pará that women learn to perform self-exams early, while men resist prostate tests, prompting opposition criticism. He highlighted the first robotic prostate surgery in Northern Brazil and advocated for cancer prevention. His campaign asked the TSE to act against posts by lawmaker Nikolas Ferreira.

item.title: TSE volta atrás e permite post de Erika Hilton sobre Nossa Senhora e Flávio
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça reversed restrictions on a post by lawmaker Erika Hilton (PSol) referencing Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and a 2007 bill proposing to revoke the title of Patroness of Brazil from Our Lady of Aparecida. Mendonça ruled the mention of Flávio as conditional, allowing restoration of the post, but maintained removal of claims directly linking him or his family to proposing or supporting the bill. The decision highlights electoral tensions around religious themes and controversial candidacies.

item.title: Em debate, Haddad usa prisão de Milton Leite para atacar Tarcísio e Nunes
item.description: In a Globo debate, Haddad used Milton Leite's arrest to criticize Tarcísio and Nunes for alleged improper involvement. Tarcísio responded, claiming his relationship with the Leite family was institutional. The debate followed a campaign event involving family members of Leite.

item.title: Haddad questiona Tarcísio sobre apoio a filhos de Milton Leite
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) questioned Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) for seeking votes for the children of Milton Leite, former president of the São Paulo City Council, labeling him a 'shadow mayor' and demanding explanations about supporting someone who would be arrested 15 days later.

item.title: TSE manda incluir candidatos do Novo em debates eleitorais
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, ordered the inclusion of candidates from the Novo party in the 2026 electoral debates, responding to a request from the party's national directory and benefiting Romeu Zema, Kiko Caputo, and André Marinho.

item.title: Caso Nossa Senhora: a interferência direta no resultado da eleição, segundo advogado eleitoral
item.description: Electoral lawyer Arthur Rollo warns that clashes between the STF and TSE over the Nossa Senhora Aparecida case may impact election outcomes due to divergent single-judge decisions and legal uncertainty. He criticizes 'relator fishing' and internal divisions weakening the TSE's authority.

item.title: Ricardo Salles acompanha Tarcísio em debate da Globo
item.description: Deputy Ricardo Salles, who recently withdrew his Senate candidacy, joined Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) at the TV Glovo debate for São Paulo governor. The delegation included allies André do Prado (PL) and Guilherme Derrite (PP). This was the second and final debate before the first-round vote on Sunday.

item.title: Após depositar R$ 325 mi para apostas, amigo de Flávio pede bloqueio de dinheiro de bet; Justiça nega
item.description: São Paulo Justice denied the freezing of R$145.5 million from betting operator Blaze, in a lawsuit filed by Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro and under investigation for fraud. The amount corresponds to the lawyer's losses on the platform and a moral damages claim he himself requested. The case involves parallel investigations into irregularities in the gaming sector and suspected money laundering.

item.title: Lula critica ACM Neto por autodeclaração de cor e elo com Vorcaro
item.description: Lula criticized ACM Neto over changes to his racial self-declaration and ties to Daniel Vorcaro, rejecting any alliance. The former mayor declared himself white to electoral authorities in 2026, after switching from white to brown in 2022. Lula urged votes for Jeronimo Rodrigues, Jaques Wagner, and Rui Costa.

item.title: Lula ataca Flávio Bolsonaro e diz que única experiência do adversário é com milicianos
item.description: During a campaign event in Salvador, President Lula attacked Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming his only experience is with militia members and money laundering. The statement takes place in a tense electoral context, with both candidates competing for recognition and votes in the 2026 elections.

item.title: O que indica crescimento de petista em pesquisa em estado chave das eleições, segundo diretor da Quaest
item.description: The growth of Patrus Ananias (PT) in the Minas Gerais race reflects the consolidation of the PT candidacy among left-wing voters. According to a Quaest intelligence director, the increase is due to the electorate identifying the PT and Lula candidate. The trend also reveals a weakening of Alexandre Kalil, who trails behind leaders like Cleitinho Azevedo and Patrus in the polls.

item.title: PCC, Cracolândia e herança de gestões: Tarcísio e Haddad têm confronto sobre segurança e saúde no debate em SP
item.description: In the TV Globo debate, Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad discussed public security, health, and tax exemptions, with Haddad accusing the São Paulo government of maintaining a 'black box' of business benefits, citing TCE criticism. Tarcísio defended transparency and the fiscal incentive cuts made by his administration, denying any lack of oversight.

item.title: Janja chama Nikolas de “piá de bosta”
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva called congressman Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) a 'piece of shit' after he took President Lula's statement about women out of context. The remarks were made during a campaign event in Salvador, where Janja criticized attempts to politicize the president's words. The PT considered the backlash an attempt to distort the original statement.

item.title: Brasil deve se proteger de importações predatórias, diz ex-ministro
item.description: Armando Monteiro, former Minister of Development, advocates for trade protection measures to shield the Brazilian industry from predatory imports, highlighting the impact of Brazil Cost on national competitiveness. He emphasizes the need for balance, avoiding protectionism that encourages inefficiencies through continuously reassessed policies.

item.title: Nikolas responde a Lula e Janja: “Canalha é quem não assume o que falou”
item.description: Federal representative Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) responded to attacks from President Lula and First Lady Janja, calling them 'scoundrels' during a campaign event in Patos de Minas. Nikolas questioned why Lula would have 'lost his line' and considered the attacks a form of praising him. The exchange of accusations was widely discussed on social media.

item.title: Lula presta solidariedade a bispos e diz que 'todas religiões' são atacadas quando uma é alvo de políticos
item.description: President Lula (PT) expressed solidarity with the Brazilian National Conference of Bishops (CNBB) after Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) accused the group of spreading fake news against him. In his statement, Lula emphasized that attacks on one religion are attacks on all Brazilian religions. The statement comes amid tensions between politicians and religious institutions.

item.title: Eduardo Paes e Douglas Ruas se enfrentam no debate da Globo com menções a Lula, Cabral, Castro e Bacellar
item.description: In the Globo debate, Eduardo Paes and Douglas Ruas discussed issues like transportation, employment, and education, mentioning figures such as Lula, Cabral, Castro, and Bacellar. Ruas criticized Paes and referenced his support for Lula, while Paes countered by linking Ruas to Castro and Witzel. The debate also featured interventions from William Siri, André Marinho, and Anthony Garotinho.

item.title: Lula explica fala sobre toque, e Janja ataca Nikolas: 'Piá de bosta'
item.description: Lula clarified he was referring to health exams when saying 'women learn to take touch';Janja called Nikolas a 'piece of shit' amid controversy over the deputy's video.

item.title: Lula chama Nikolas de “canalha” após vídeo sobre “tomar toque”
item.description: President Lula called federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira a 'scoundrel' after the lawmaker released a video criticizing the PT leader's remarks about women taking touch exams. Nikolas allegedly created a new context for Lula's original statement. The controversy sparks fresh political confrontation.

item.title: Publicitário ligado a Vorcaro diz que Lula deveria ser preso
item.description: Advertiser Thiago Miranda, under investigation for his ties to Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master, stated that President Lula should be arrested, showing support for Flávio Bolsonaro. According to the Federal Police, he acted as an intermediary to fund the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Nunes Marques muda entendimento do TSE e inclui Novo em debates eleitorais
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques granted an injunction to the Partido Novo, modifying the criteria for participation in electoral debates for 2026. The decision allows Novo candidates such as Kiko Caputo, André Marinho, and Romeu Zema to participate in debates on radio and TV, including broadcasts by TV Globo. The TSE revised the representativeness table, considering post-election affiliations, arguing that the restrictive interpretation unjustifiably limited public debate.

item.title: Governo amplia prazo de adesão ao Simples Nacional 2027
item.description: The federal government extended, through Resolution 194/2026 of the CGSN, deadlines for micro and small businesses to opt for the Simples Nacional 2027 and define the IBS and CBS collection regime. Companies wishing to join or return to the Simples have until October 15 to apply, effective from January 1, 2027, while those already enrolled opting for the regular IBS and CBS regime have until October 30. The measure followed discussions between CGSN, Sebrae, and the Federal Accounting Council.

item.title: Fachin adia discussão sobre publicações de Nossa Senhora no STF
item.description: STF President Edson Fachin postponed the agenda regarding conflicting TSE decisions involving Our Lady posts during Flávio Bolsonaro's election campaign. The legal impasse arose after André Mendonça ordered a post removed, a decision later reversed by Flávio Dino and subsequently reinstated by Luiz Fux.

item.title: Lula chama Nikolas de 'canalha' por explorar fala sobre exame ginecológico e Janja eleva o tom: 'Piá de bosta'
item.description: At a campaign event in Salvador, President Lula criticized Congressman Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) for exploiting his remarks about gynecological exams. First Lady Janja da Silva also attacked the lawmaker, calling him a 'worthless kid'. Lula claimed his words were distorted and defended the importance of discussing health issues.

item.title: A primeira pesquisa Datafolha após o embate sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida
item.description: Datafolha will release on Thursday the first survey measuring the impact of the debate surrounding Our Lady of Aparecida, a topic that gained momentum after discussions about a bill archived nearly 20 years ago aiming to remove the saint's title as Brazil's patroness. The poll, commissioned by Grupo Globo and Folha de S.Paulo, interviews 2,506 voters between September 28 and October 1, with a margin of error of two percentage points and 95% confidence. In the previous poll, Lula led with 40% of voting intentions in the first round, closely followed by Flávio Bolsonaro, while in the second round the two were tied technically.

item.title: TSE amplia exigências para registro de pesquisas eleitorais; institutos criticam mudança nas regras durante a eleição
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) expanded requirements for registering electoral polls in the PesqEle system, demanding more details on methodology, sampling, and questionnaires. The new rules, effective from October 5, were criticized by polling institutes for being implemented during the electoral process. The Brazilian Association of Research Companies (Abep) questions the timing and procedure of the change.

item.title: TRE mantém indeferida candidatura de Garatotinho a governador
item.description: The Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court upheld the rejection of Anthony Garatotinho's gubernatorial candidacy after reviewing appeals. His defense team plans to appeal to the Supreme Electoral Court, while his ineligibility due to administrative misconduct may lead to vote invalidation in the first round.

item.title: Eleição terá ônibus de graça e 4 mil viagens extras em BH
item.description: The Belo Horizonte City Hall provides free buses and 4,000 additional trips for voting access in the 2026 elections. The operation includes weekday routes and special traffic monitoring in strategic polling areas. Free fares apply to all municipal bus lines and are guaranteed by local law and TSE resolution.

item.title: Lula chega forte à reta final, diz diretor da Quaest sobre o 1º turno
item.description: President Lula enters the final stretch of the first round strengthened, according to Guilherme Russo, director of intelligence at Quaest. Recent polls show Lula reversing his earlier loss of ground to Flávio Bolsonaro, currently leading in momentum, though undecided voters and factors like debates and news may still influence the final outcome. The scenario resembles 2022, with undecided voters tending to follow the current trend favoring Lula.

item.title: Richarlison cobra Willer Tomaz após matéria sobre bets e cita mansão
item.description: Richarlison criticized Willer Tomaz after a report revealed the lawyer bet nearly $1 billion on online games in 2025. His comment referenced their ongoing legal dispute over the ownership of a $2 million mansion in Angra dos Reis.

item.title: Ministério da Justiça vai fiscalizar se loterias estaduais cumprem as regras de proibição das bets
item.description: The Ministry of Justice will monitor state lotteries in nine states to ensure compliance with the ban on online betting sites. Over 5,209 websites and 186 applications have been blocked, with additional actions taken on social media platforms. The measure aims to combat gambling addiction and family over-indebtedness, following the executive order signed by President Lula.

item.title: Willer Tomaz aponta movimentação de R$ 10 bilhões em apostas e vai à Justiça contra plataforma para ter valores perdidos devolvidos
item.description: Lawyer Willer Tomaz filed a lawsuit against a betting platform, claiming losses of 163.2 million reais and a turnover of 10 billion reais in online gambling in 2025, seeking reimbursement and compensation after being diagnosed with gambling addiction. His defense argues the platform allowed continued access despite blocking requests, and the case is being handled at the 44th Civil Court in São Paulo.

item.title: Nunes Marques manda Globo incluir Romeu Zema em debate
item.description: TSE Minister Kassio Nunes Marques ordered TV Globo to include New Party candidate Romeu Zema in the upcoming Thursday electoral debate. The ruling responded to a formal request from the New Party's National Directory, citing the party's congressional representation and lack of invitation to Zema and other candidates. The electoral law interpretation ensures participation for parties represented in the National Congress.

item.title: Os Estados Unidos estão tentando interferir na eleição brasileira?
item.description: BBC News Brasil examined potential signs of U.S. interference in Brazilian elections, analyzing connections between the Brazilian right and American conservative groups, as well as the revival of the Monroe Doctrine in Latin America. Experts warn about the risk of external influence through campaign funding, disinformation, and diplomatic pressure, though concrete evidence remains limited.

item.title: Presença de Lula faz aliados despontarem em disputa ao Senado no Piauí
item.description: Lula's visit to Piauí strengthened Marcelo Castro and Júlio César as the main pro-petlist Senate candidates, marginalizing Ciro Nogueira.

item.title: Em PE, Lula soma mais que o dobro de votos em relação a Flávio: 58% a 20%, diz Quaest
item.description: A new Quaest poll in Pernambuco shows President Lula (PT) with 58% of voting intentions in the first round, more than triple those for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), who has 20%. In the simulated runoff, Lula leads with 61% against 24% for Flávio, maintaining a significant advantage.

item.title: Fachin deixa caso sobre Flávio e Nossa Senhora Aparecida fora da pauta do STF
item.description: The president of the STF, Edson Fachin, kept the case regarding fake news involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Our Lady of Aparecida out of the court's agenda, temporarily suspending the decision.

item.title: TSE estuda impedir suspeitos de terem ligação com organizações criminosas de disputarem eleições
item.description: The TSE is considering barring candidates linked to criminal organizations from running in elections, even without a judicial conviction, based on the acceptance of charges by the justice system. The decision is expected between the first and second rounds of the election.

item.title: Marco Polo diz que Brasil precisa reagir a importações “predatórias”
item.description: Marco Polo de Mello, executive president of the Aço Brasil Institute, warned about predatory imports and advocated for the recovery of the domestic steel market, noting that imports reached 5.7 million tons in 2025, equivalent to one-third of the sector's sales. He highlighted the industry's resilience and emphasized that the sector's agenda does not depend on the outcome of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Kotscho: Esqueletos saem do armário e assombram Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Columnist Ricardo Kotscho states that new revelations involving Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) may not shake his core base but could sway undecided voters in the final stretch of the campaign. The allegations include skeletons brought to light that may impact the candidate's public image.
